vulnerability.explanation: When freeing a single sPLT entry (num != -1), the code indexes info_ptr->splt_palettes[num] without any bounds check against info_ptr->splt_palettes_num. An out-of-range num leads to out-of-bounds access and writes (setting fields to NULL) and also calls png_free() on an out-of-bounds pointer, causing heap corruption/invalid free.
